title: Maria at the Supermarket
text:
Maria goes to the supermarket on Saturday morning. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has milk, eggs, bread, and apples. She takes a basket and starts to look for the food.

In the fruit section, she finds red apples and yellow bananas. Then she goes to the dairy section for milk and eggs. At the end, she pays at the cashier and goes home with her bags. Maria is happy because she remembered everything on the list.

questions.text: What day does Maria go to the supermarket?
What does Maria buy in the dairy section?
Why is Maria happy at the end?
options: She bought everything on her list
She paid a lot of money

questions.text: Why does Maria have a shopping list?
options: To help her remember what to buy

vocabulary.definition: a set of words or items written one after another
a container used to carry things, such as food in a shop
one part of a shop where a certain kind of product is sold
the person who takes money from customers in a shop

paragraph_translations: Maria vai ao supermercado no sábado de manhã. Ela tem uma lista de compras na mão. A lista tem leite, ovos, pão e maçãs. Ela pega uma cesta e começa a procurar a comida.

Na seção de frutas, ela encontra maçãs vermelhas e bananas amarelas. Depois, ela vai à seção de laticínios para comprar leite e ovos. No final, ela paga no caixa e volta para casa com as sacolas. Maria está feliz porque se lembrou de tudo da lista.
